Use to read how the portal kit unlocks and fires. Not used up.

PORTAL KIT
Unlock by reading Wiring magazines until Electrician reaches 25, and spend perk points in Advanced Engineering. Craft at a workbench.

PORTAL GUN
Left click blue, right click orange, middle click clears both. The top HUD lights show which colours are out and whether they are linked. A lone portal is a static opening. Place both colours and they link — walk through and you come out the other with facing and speed transformed. Linked portals show the view through the partner.

GEL GUN
Craft Repulsion/Propulsion Goo as ammo. Reload with R. The HUD on the right shows the magazine. Left click blue bounce gel, right click orange speed gel. Bounce height follows how hard you came in.

LONG-FALL BOOTS
Feet slot, like other shoes. Light armor, a little run speed, and no fall damage while they are on. Take them off and falling hurts again. Wear these before you bounce off high blue gel.

WEIGHTED CUBE
Place and pick up. Scrap-steel crate with a heart on it.

SURFACES
Metal rejects. Needs two adjacent solid cubes or terrain voxels — a wall portal is one wide and two tall, a floor portal is two side by side. A 3x4 pad is plenty. Off-centre shots snap to the nearest pair. Plants, wedges, doors, and plates reject. Nothing can sit on the face (no portal under a workbench).
